rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the image and lab grade, noting a full/early-full blastocyst with visible cavity and compact ICM, but it overstates confidence in A-grade TE/ICM from a single static image and does not discuss the somewhat uneven TE distribution/zona in detail.

Integrates age, BMI, PCOS, first cycle status, sperm parameters, endometrial thickness, and oocyte yield well with prognosis, though AMH absence and fresh-vs-frozen implications could be tied even more tightly to this specific transfer.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis flowing from embryo grade and favorable patient factors; minor issue is slight tension between describing the image as early-full transition while accepting reported 2AA/full blastocyst without much reconciliation.

Recommendations are broadly evidence-based: SET favored, caution about OHSS in PCOS, avoid routine add-ons, and PGT-A not routinely necessary at age 31. Small deviations include somewhat speculative comments about progesterone/elevated response without supporting cycle data.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support attention, OHSS vigilance, and when to investigate further after failure; useful though not highly protocol-specific.
